Name: Community Center Bundles Randomizer
Author: ThePaladinTheo
Description: Changes the community center bundles to have random accessible items. Always can be finished in the first year. It uses a spreadsheet that lists which rooms should have which items; no coconuts in the Crafts Room or Pantry before the beach bus is unlocked. Item quantities and qualities mean that you can't expect to just buy your way through it.

Manifest.Name: Community Center Bundles Randomizer
